```{css, echo=FALSE}
.title{
  font-size: 30px;
  color: #3070BF;
  background-color: #fff;
  padding: 0px;
}

/* ---- Theme labels: small colored pills (text darkened so it's readable) ---- */
.sched .info, .sched .cli, .sched .git, .sched .repro, .sched .reldata,
.sched .sql, .sched .py, .sched .pyprac, .sched .ai, .sched .proj {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.15em 0.65em;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.92em;
  line-height: 1.35;
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.sched .info    { background-color: #EEF0F2; color: #5A6268; border-color: #D5D9DD; }
.sched .cli     { background-color: #FCF0DC; color: #9A5A06; border-color: #F3D7A6; }
.sched .git     { background-color: #FCE7F0; color: #AE2F66; border-color: #F5C2D9; }
.sched .repro   { background-color: #E3F1FE; color: #1F6DB5; border-color: #B9DBFB; }
.sched .reldata { background-color: #DDEEEE; color: #2E6B69; border-color: #B5D6D5; }
.sched .sql     { background-color: #D3E8E7; color: #245856; border-color: #A6CDCB; }
.sched .py      { background-color: #DCE6F5; color: #28599A; border-color: #B5C9E8; }
.sched .pyprac  { background-color: #ECE6F5; color: #5A3F8A; border-color: #D2C6E6; }
.sched .ai      { background-color: #FBE3E2; color: #A12B28; border-color: #F2BDBB; }
.sched .proj    { background-color: #F8EAF0; color: #8C2A52; border-color: #EBC3D4; }

/* ---- Header row ---- */
.sched table thead th {
  background-color: #3070BF;
  color: white;
  border-bottom: none;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.sched table thead th a { color: white; }

/* ---- Scroll sideways on small screens instead of squishing ---- */
.sched { overflow-x: auto; }
.sched table { min-width: 900px; }

/* ---- Due-date rows ---- */
.sched table tbody tr:has(.setup-row) td,
.sched table tbody tr:has(.check-row) td,
.sched table tbody tr:has(.proj-row) td,
.sched table tbody tr:has(.lab-row) td{
  background-color: #F8EAF0 !important;
  color: #B3346A;  /* slightly darker pink so it's readable */
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* ---- Blank separator rows: any row whose cells are all empty turns blue ---- */
.sched table tbody tr:not(:has(td:not(:empty))) td {
  background-color: #3070BF !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;   /* stops Bootstrap's striping from covering it */
  padding: 0 !important;
  height: 10px;
  line-height: 0;
  border: none;
}

.sched table th:nth-of-type(1) { width: 5% !important; }
.sched table th:nth-of-type(2) { width: 6% !important; }
.sched table th:nth-of-type(3) { width: 5% !important; }
.sched table th:nth-of-type(4) { width: 13% !important; }
.sched table th:nth-of-type(5) { width: 17% !important; }
.sched table th:nth-of-type(6) { width: 30% !important; }
.sched table th:nth-of-type(7) { width: 16% !important; }
.sched table th:nth-of-type(8) { width: 8% !important; }
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
source(here("class_dates.R"))
```

The course runs 10 weeks with two lessons a week. SQL and Python each get two full weeks. I may adjust the schedule if we need more or less time on a topic.

::: sched
| Week | Date | Les-son | Theme | Topic | Focus | Data | Reading |
|:-------|:-------|:-------|--------|:-------|:-------|:-------|:------:|
| 1 | `{r} w1d1 %>% format("%m/%d")` | 1 | [Intro to health data science]{.info} | Health data science workflows | Welcome and syllabus. The data science life cycle and what a reproducible workflow looks like. Set up R projects and Quarto. | Course examples from NHANES | [VDS](https://vdsbook.com/) |
|  | `{r} w1d2 %>% format("%m/%d")` | 2 | [Intro to health data science]{.info} | The health data landscape | Where each kind of data comes from, its usual formats, and who on a research team works with it. | Short samples of EHR, claims, genomics, imaging, and wearable data | [VDS](https://vdsbook.com/) |
|  | `{r} setup %>% format("%m/%d")` |  |  | [[Week 1 setup assignment due](syllabus.qmd#week-1-setup-assignment)]{.setup-row} |  |  |  |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

**Reading key:** [VDS](https://vdsbook.com/) = *Veridical Data Science*; [Shell](https://swcarpentry.github.io/shell-novice/) = *The Unix Shell* (Software Carpentry); [DSatCL](https://jeroenjanssens.com/dsatcl/) = *Data Science at the Command Line*; [Happy Git](https://happygitwithr.com/) = *Happy Git and GitHub for the useR*; [renv](https://rstudio.github.io/renv/) = renv documentation; [Intro SQL](https://intro-sql-fh.netlify.app/) = *Intro to SQL* (Fred Hutch); [PDA](https://wesmckinney.com/book/) = *Python for Data Analysis*; [R4DS](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/) = *R for Data Science*; [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/guide/) = Quarto guide.

Weeks 5 and 6 use EHR data only as practice material for SQL, not to teach EHR methods.
